0022600161.text: The Knicks host the Brooklyn Nets in New York's seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with New York at 2-4 overall, 1-2 at home, 11th in the East, and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic after losing their last game, and Jose Alvarado is out with an ankle sprain. Brooklyn is 1-5 overall, 0-3 at home, and 15th in the East, having won its most recent game, but Egor Demin and Tyler Bilodeau are out with a leg bruise and a shoulder sprain, and Mikel Brown Jr. is day-to-day with a rest-related game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and the Knicks won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
